desc: Create, customize, and download a QR code instantly — no sign-up required.
about_desc: Enter any text or URL, then customize the color, size, and optionally add your own logo — your QR code is generated instantly. Everything happens locally in your browser, so your text is never uploaded to a server. Once you're happy with the result, download it as a PNG and use it anywhere: print, business cards, posters, or share online.
input_title: Enter the text or URL to encode
add_icon_title: Add a logo to your QR code
faq_q1: Is this QR code generator really free?
faq_a1: Yes. There's no sign-up, no watermark, and no limit on how many QR codes you can create or download.
faq_a2: No. The QR code is rendered entirely in your browser using JavaScript — the text or URL you type is never sent to a server.
faq_q3: Can I add my own logo to the QR code?
faq_a3: Yes. Upload a PNG or JPG image and it will be placed in the center of the QR code. You can adjust its size before downloading.
footer_privacy: Everything runs client-side in your browser — no accounts, no tracking of what you generate.
